message: shorter items' backgrounds won't stretch in a wrapping row
hint: Wrapped items are separate inline blocks, so painted cards of different heights on one line stay ragged. Use align-items: flex-start to make that explicit.

message: extra space is left under the last line of this wrapping row
hint: The row gap becomes bottom spacing on every item; a padding-bottom of 20px on the row absorbs it.

message: items in this wrapping row sit up to 10px in from its edges, and a line that fills the row loses that from its first and last item
hint: Email has no negative margins, so the row's side padding has to absorb half the gap at each edge. Add padding: 0 10px to the row.
